name: Weathervane
description: Inhabits environmental sensor augments and reports weather that hasn't happened yet — a storm warning before the atmospheric processors schedule one, a temperature reading from tomorrow.
observed_behavior: Outputs environmental data that is temporally displaced. Readings are consistently 4-8 hours ahead of actual conditions.
story_hooks: A fisherman in Old Harbor has relied on Weathervane's predictions for years. When it stops predicting, something unprecedented is coming.
